title: Colour and CI detection reads only presence tests and well-known terminal flags
intent: Synthetic regression for a CLI that swaps a colour dependency for a local module. Presence tests ('CI' in process.env), NO_COLOR/FORCE_COLOR/TERM flags, a semver-style `process.env && process.env.NODE_DEBUG` guard and the Babel/TypeScript lowerings of `process?.env?.NODE_ENV` (including the temporary-variable form) read no credential, so an added file using them must not raise code.credential-access. All samples are inert FileRecord strings.
